name: vibe-ops
description: Workspace root. The Claude Code plugin lives in plugin/ and has no build; the CLI's packages live in cli/packages/.

scripts._comment_build: core first, explicitly. `--workspaces` runs in directory order, not dependency order, so `cli` sorts before `core` and would typecheck against its stale dist and report success.
scripts.build: npm run build:foundation && npm run build --workspaces --if-present

_comment_overrides: tree-sitter-markdown@0.3.2 declares a peer of tree-sitter ^0.21.1; the pin is 0.25.1, measured (2026-08-10, project/tasks/001-the-document-model-and-its-sensor.md) to produce a byte-for-byte identical parse tree across 0.21.1/0.22.4/0.25.1 on darwin-arm64. The peer range is conservative, not load-bearing.
